_comment: §C substitution/echo: carries ${resource.id} (test-controlled) into query/header/body, incl. an embedded template (customer-${resource.id}). Hits the static-config echo rule (/api/v1/pip/ra/echo) which returns the received request; response.extract=$.method binds 'POST'. The test asserts (via GET /pip-stub/calls) exactly what substitution + x-request-id put on the wire.
name: subject.raEchoMethod

_comment: §C whole-value array for IN: POST + tenant query + Customer requestAttributes body matches the static allowed-ids rule → {data:{ids:[{id:C1},{id:C2},{id:C3}]}}; extract $.data.ids[*].id → [C1,C2,C3] bound for an IN predicate.
name: subject.raAllowedIds

_comment: §E timeout-uses-default: timeoutSeconds:1 against the slow-upstream rule (delayMs:3000, still returns a valid body) forces a client timeout; raise_error:false + defaultValue rescues the alias so the decision proceeds on [TIMEOUT-DEFAULT].
name: subject.raSlowIds

_comment: §D hard http failure: a 500 with onMissing:error and no defaultValue leaves the alias ABSENT (kind http_error) so the leaf that uses it fails closed — including under negation.
name: subject.raBrokenId
